system.description:
With sharpened claws or teeth, you make a flurry of gouging strikes. Make two melee Taijutsu attacks dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] if using a weapon) +2d4. If you deal damage as part of casting this jutsu, the affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw, being knocked prone on a failure.

Tag-Team: Your Nin-Dog follows up with sharp fangs and claws. They make a melee Taijutsu attack, dealing their Bite damage. If they deal damage as part of this Tag-Team, if the affected creature fails their original save, they gain a rank of Bleed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage you deal by +1d4. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of attacks your Nin-Dog makes by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of attacks you make by +1.
